name: North Carolina
status_why: The Board's plain JSON text files answered scripts; Nov 3 is registered.
office: the North Carolina State Board of Elections
system: State-built: the State Board of Elections' results site er.ncsbe.gov, with plain JSON text files and precinct zips on dl.ncsbe.gov (Cloudflare and S3).

results_page.label: North Carolina State Board of Elections: election results

feeds.address: https://er.ncsbe.gov/enr/elections.txt (list: edt date, con, vtm, pct, arc flags); https://er.ncsbe.gov/enr/<yyyymmdd>/data/county.txt (each county's precincts reporting, ballots cast, title 'UNOFFICIAL/OFFICIAL ...'); https://er.ncsbe.gov/enr/<yyyymmdd>/data/results_<n>.txt (contest results by group)
feeds.updates: Every few minutes on election night as counties upload.
feeds.note: elections.txt answered 200 on 2026-10-09 and already lists 11/03/2026 (con 1, vtm 1, pct 1, arc 0). 20241105/data/county.txt answered 200 (title '11/05/2024 OFFICIAL GENERAL ELECTION RESULTS - STATEWIDE', 2658 precincts). Server cloudflare, no challenge.

feeds.address: https://dl.ncsbe.gov/ENRS/<yyyy_mm_dd>/results_pct_<yyyymmdd>.zip (tab-separated: County, Election Date, Precinct, Contest Group ID, Contest Type, Choice, Choice Party, Vote For, Election Day, Early Voting, Absentee by Mail, Provisional, Total Votes)
feeds.note: nc.py reads the March 3 file; the 2024 one is at ENRS/2024_11_05/.

races_in_feed: Every contest the Board and county boards run: federal, statewide, legislature, judges (partisan), county commission, school boards, soil and water, and municipal contests on the November ballot.
local: No need: all 100 counties report into er.ncsbe.gov; Wake and Mecklenburg also post their own pages (not checked).
how_counted: North Carolina reports Election Day, early voting, mail and provisional ballots separately.
count_order: Election Day, Early Voting, Absentee by Mail and Provisional per precinct (precinct zip).
vote_types: Yes: Election Day, Early Voting, Absentee by Mail and Provisional columns per precinct (the vtm flag in elections.txt marks vote-type data).

certify.body: the North Carolina State Board of Elections
certify.rule: Meets not more than 10 days after the Tuesday three weeks after the election (N.C. Gen. Stat. 163-182.5(c)).
certify.local_rule: County canvass at 11 a.m. on the 10th day (163-182.5(b)).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

scout_plan: Live-readable, one of the best feeds anywhere: the Nov 3 election is already registered. On election night read county.txt and the results files every 3 minutes, and the precinct zip every 15 minutes for vote types and roll-off. Local contests are in the same files.
notes: Vote types: evc Election Day, ovc one-stop (early in person), avc absentee by mail, pvc provisional (they add up to vct on every line of the 2024 files).
A county's file is asked for only when its row in county.txt changed, at most 40 a cycle on the night.
sources: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
